checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Same face, ears, coat and pose; beach one is nearly identical, snow one is a bit paler and slightly different, but still recognisable.

must.item: Locations are beach, snowy forest trail, cosy living room
must.why: Each setting is clear: sea and sand, snowy pines on a path, sofa, lamp and fireplace on a rug.

must.item: Natural integration, scale, lighting, ground contact
must.why: Lighting and shadows fit each scene. The snow dog has soft ground contact, and the beach dog's tail looks slightly odd.

faults.what: All three use the same front-facing seated pose copied from the reference, so the shots look repetitive and somewhat pasted-in.
The snow-trail dog's coat is paler and its tail and feet are slightly mushy against the snow.
The beach tail looks slightly odd, and the living-room dog's legs and paws are a little soft.

summary: Three convincing square photos of the same golden retriever on a beach, a snowy trail and in a cosy living room; the identity holds, and the only problems are the repeated pose and small softness in the paws and tail.
